summary: Generator POP that creates a specified number of points, randomly or in a predictable pattern, on the surface of a mathematical shape or inside a closed shape volume. Use it as a finite source for point clouds, particle seeds, and POP attribute experiments when the source is a sphere, box, torus, tube, rectangle, circle, or line rather than input polygons.

key_params.name: shape
key_params.note: Mathematical source shape: sphere, box, torus, tube, rectangle, circle, or line.

key_params.name: createpointprim
key_params.note: Creates point primitives for the generated points.

key_params.name: numpoints
key_params.note: Number of points generated by the POP.

key_params.name: distribution
key_params.note: Chooses surface distribution or volume distribution.

key_params.name: random
key_params.note: Enables random distribution; when off, generation is predictable but patterned.

key_params.name: seed
key_params.note: Initializes randomization for repeatable random distributions.

key_params.name: orient
key_params.note: Orientation axis or plane for the generated shape.

key_params.name: radius
key_params.note: Radius controls used by rounded shapes such as sphere, torus, tube, and circle.

key_params.name: pointa
key_params.note: First endpoint for Line shape generation.

key_params.name: pointb
key_params.note: Second endpoint for Line shape generation.

key_params.name: normal
key_params.note: Creates an N float3 normal attribute and chooses the attribute class.

key_params.name: normaldirection
key_params.note: Chooses default or randomized normal directions.

key_params.name: dotangent
key_params.note: Creates a T float4 tangent attribute with default or randomized tangent modes.

key_params.name: xord
key_params.note: Transform Page order for scale, rotate, and translate operations.

key_params.name: rord
key_params.note: Rotate Order for composing X/Y/Z rotations.

key_params.name: r
key_params.note: Rotate generated points around X/Y/Z in degrees.

key_params.name: p
key_params.note: Pivot used when rotating and scaling the generated shape.

key_params.name: freeextragpumem
key_params.note: Frees accumulated GPU memory after output sizes have grown and shrunk.

key_params.name: delinputattrs
key_params.note: Deletes input attributes that are not explicitly output, useful for isolating branches.

common_gotchas: Volume distribution expects a closed shape; with non-closed surfaces the Point Generator POP still distributes points around holes instead of guaranteeing true inside-volume sampling.

The official docs note there is presently no option for distribution to be uniform per unit surface area; for example, triangles may receive approximately the same number of points even when their areas differ.
When Random is off, the output is repeatable but patterned, so turn Random on and set Seed deliberately when the source should avoid visible regular structure.
Line mode uses Point A and Point B in XYZ to define the line segment, so Size, Radius, and Height are not the controls to reach for in that shape mode.
Normal and Tangent generation creates N and T attribute vectors; check whether the downstream POP or render path expects point, vertex, or primitive attribute ownership.
Use Delete Input Attributes with care when this generator is part of a branch that must preserve existing attributes for later Math Mix, GLSL POP, or rendering steps.
Use a downstream Null POP and Info CHOP/bounds inspection before rendering dense point clouds.
build_relevance: 2025.30000+ generator for finite POP point-cloud and particle-source workflows
